crossrefs.text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lordʼs coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Jobʼs perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.

He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
Then He adds, “Here I am, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first to establish the second.
For in my inner being I delight in Godʼs law.

“What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.
Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.”

notes.title: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire

crossrefs.text: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servantʼs well-being.”
The poor and needy seek water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.
Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
